title: NE555 LED blinker (about 1 Hz)
finish: All parts are placed. Check the wiring against manual page 11, then connect 5 to 9 volts. The LED should blink about once per second.

steps.instruction: Place the breadboard flat in front of the camera so the whole board is visible.
steps.tip: Top-down view, desk lamp on, avoid glare from the overhead light.

steps.instruction: Place the NE555 timer across the centre channel of the breadboard, notch to the left.

expect.label: ic
expect.zone_hint: Put the IC in the middle of the board, straddling the centre channel.

steps.tip: Each pin needs its own column. Pin 1 is next to the notch.

steps.instruction: Add R1 (1 kilo-ohm: brown, black, red) and R2 (68 kilo-ohm: blue, grey, orange) next to the IC.
steps.tip: R1 goes from pin 8 to pin 7. R2 goes from pin 7 to pin 6. Join pins 6 and 2.

steps.instruction: Add the 10 microfarad electrolytic capacitor from pin 2 to ground, stripe to ground.
steps.tip: The stripe with minus signs marks the negative lead. It must go to ground.

steps.instruction: Add the LED and its 330 ohm resistor (orange, orange, brown) from pin 3 to ground.
steps.tip: Long leg (anode) toward pin 3 through the resistor, short leg to ground.

steps.instruction: Final check: IC, three resistors, capacitor and LED are all on the board.
